newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end mixed, S&P off slightly.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end mixed, S&P off slightly.

text.p: May 28 - U.S. stock index futures ended mixed, with June S&P down but off the lows. Traders said June made a small comeback in last half-hour, but overall trade was quiet. Trader said Nikkei futures saw buying late to bring it near 20,350.0. Overall, traders said S&P 500 pausing after record highs.
